div.head: II Cn 49
div.ab: Gif hwa hadbryce gewyrce, gebete þæt be hades mæðe, swa be were swa be wite swa be lahslite swa be ealre are.
Gyf hwá hadbryce gewyrce, gebete þæt be ðæs hades mæðe, swa be were swa be wite swa be lahslite swa be ealre are.
Gif hwa hadbryce gewirce, gebete þæt be hades mæðe, swa be were swa be wite swa be lahslite swa be ealre are.
Si quis ordinis infracturam faciat, emendet hoc secundum ordinis dignitatem: wera, wita, láhslite et omni misericordia (seu per omnia que possidet).

Quicunque uiolauerit ordinem, sicut est aut monachum aut presbyterum aut aliquem ordinatum uerberauerit aut aliquid huiusmodi fecerit, hęc ita emendet secundum modum ordinis patientis: aut secundum prętium, id est þere, aut secundum forisfacturam aut secundum omnia quę habet malefactor.
[49] Si quis ordinis fracturam facit, emendet hoc iuxta ordinis dignitatem: siue per redempcionem siue per forisfacturam siue per legis transgressionem siue per totam substantiam suam.
Gif hwá hadbryce gewyrce, gebete þæt be ðæs hades mæðe, swa be were swa be wite swa be lahslite swa be ealre are.
Gif hwa hadbryce gewyrce, gebete þæt be hades mæðe, swa be were swa be wite swa be lahslite swa be ealre are.

Wenn jemand Klerus-Verletzung verübt, büsse er das nach Verhältniss des geistlichen Ranges [des Verletzten]: entweder durch [sein] Wergeld oder durch Strafgeld oder durch Rechtsbruchbusse oder durch [seinen] ganzen Besitz.
If anyone commits a violation of holy orders, let him make amends according to the rank of [the injured man's] orders: either by [his] wergild or by a fine or by lahslit or by [his] whole property.

If anyone injures one of the clergy, he shall make amends according to the rank of the person injured, either by the payment of [his] wergeld or a fine or lahslit, or by the forfeiture of all his property.

If anyone commits an offence against a man in holy orders, he is to pay compensation for it according to the status of the orders, whether by wergild or by fine or by lahslit or by all his possessions.

If anyone injures a member of the clergy, compensation must be paid according to the victim’s rank, either by the payment of wergild, a fine, lahslit, or by the confiscation of all of the offender’s property.

Zu Inst glossiert Hs. H¹² irrig, das Wergeld des Verletzten. Hier ist aber dieselbe Formel, wie eindeutig u. 51 gemeint, durchweg auf den Missetäter bezüglich. Des Erschlagenen Wergeld für dessen Sippe geht neben der hadbot einher, laut Had 2

MS H¹² wrongly glosses Inst: the wergild of the injured man. Here, however, the same formula, as is unambiguously meant below 51, refers throughout to the wrongdoer. The slain man's wergild for his kindred goes alongside the hadbot, according to Had 2
Q i wählte ebenso missverständlich unter den Bedd. von ar öfter; er setzt u. 66, 1³ venia; s. d. Wb. ‘Grundbesitz’ zu eng Schmid. Vgl. Gl Vermögenseinziehung 10e
Q i likewise frequently chose misleadingly among the meanings of ar; below 66, 1³ he puts venia; see that word in Wb. ‘Landed property’ Schmid, too narrow. Cf. Gl Vermögenseinziehung 10e
